title: TradingSession
description: A named time interval within a trading day; local clock HH:MM in Asia/Shanghai, start inclusive, end exclusive. A session crossing midnight belongs to the trading day on which it starts

sessionId.description: Stable machine id, e.g. open-auction / morning / afternoon

kind.description: Session kind: CONTINUOUS / OPEN_AUCTION / CLOSE_AUCTION / BREAK / NIGHT

crossesMidnight.description: True when the session ends after midnight (start > end); it belongs to its start trading day
